title: 400 counts, ±20
caption: For a mean of 400 counts the Poisson distribution is almost a bell curve with standard deviation σ = √400 = 20. About 68% of repeats fall within ±20 of 400, so the rate is 400 ± 20 per minute (5%).
alt: Bell curve of the probability of each count centred on 400 with standard deviation 20, with the region from 380 to 420 shaded.
description: Horizontal axis: the number of counts in one minute; vertical axis: probability per count. The curve is centred on the mean 400.
Its width is σ = √400 = 20 counts: the curve falls to 61% of its peak at 380 and 420.
The shaded area between 380 and 420 is 68% of all the probability.
